title: Austin's Budget Unveiled
meeting_type: Austin City Council Budget Work Session
summary:
*   The city's proposed budget for the upcoming 2010-2011 fiscal year was presented.
*   This meeting served as a dedicated work session for an initial, in-depth review of Austin's financial plans.
*   Potential closed-door discussions were scheduled for sensitive matters including legal advice, land acquisitions, and personnel decisions.
